shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs for Smooth Dream League Soccer Gameplay ⚽📱
shortIntro.para1: Dream League Soccer (DLS) is all about smooth passes, clean tackles, and those satisfying long shots that make you feel like prime Ronaldo 😎. While it looks simple, consistent performance still depends on your device handling animations, replays, and AI smoothly.
shortIntro.para2: Lag during a counter-attack or frame drops while defending a corner can turn an easy win into heartbreak 💔😅. The good news? DLS is friendly to most devices if you know the right specs.

intro: Below are the minimum and recommended system requirements to enjoy Dream League Soccer on Android and iOS with smooth gameplay, fast loading, and zero rage moments 😄⚽.

minimum.Internet: Not required for offline matches (big W 🏆)

recommended.Internet: Optional – only needed for online matches 🌐

ios_intro: Dream League Soccer runs beautifully on iOS 🍏. Even older iPhones handle matches smoothly thanks to good optimization and lighter graphics.

ios_recommended.title: Device
ios_recommended.value: iPhone X / XR / 11 Series or newer

ios_recommended.title: Storage
ios_recommended.value: 1.5GB+ free space for smooth updates & replays

fps_intro: DLS doesn’t need crazy FPS numbers, but smoother frames = better ball control ⚽👌.
settings_intro: Tweaking a few settings can make DLS feel way smoother, especially on budget phones 📱⚙️.

low_end.title: Graphics Quality
low_end.value: Low or Medium for stable performance

low_end.title: Crowd Detail
low_end.value: Reduce to avoid frame drops during replays

low_end.title: Replays
low_end.value: Skip or shorten to save resources

low_end.title: Background Apps
low_end.value: Close them unless you enjoy stutters 😅

high_end.title: Replays
high_end.value: Enable full replays (goal celebrations hit harder 😎)

high_end.title: Frame Stability
high_end.value: Lock smooth gameplay for consistent control

androidDevices: Samsung Galaxy A14 / A24 / A34 / S21 Series
storageIntroText: Dream League Soccer is lightweight compared to many football games, but updates still add up 📦⚽:
faqIntroText: FAQs for Dream League Soccer – quick answers for smooth wins and stress-free goals 😄⚽:

faqList.question: Is Dream League Soccer heavy on phones?
faqList.answer: No 👍 DLS is lightweight and runs well on most low to mid-range devices.

faqList.question: Can DLS run offline?
faqList.answer: Yes 📴 You can enjoy full career matches without internet.

faqList.question: Why does my game lag during replays?
faqList.answer: Crowd detail and replay animations can cause drops on low-end phones. Lower graphics to fix it.
